items.title: Delivery and installation of wardrobe
items.quote: Wir liefern und montieren ihn am Samstag, 12.12.2026; unser Team ist ab 08:00 Uhr bei Ihnen und braucht etwa drei Stunden.
items.computation: The letter states the appointment date and time directly: Saturday, 12 December 2026, starting 08:00. Appointments are kept on the date given and are not shifted for weekends.

items.title: Call to reschedule if the delivery date does not suit (conditional)
items.quote: Passt Ihnen der Tag nicht, rufen Sie uns spätestens drei Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: Only relevant if she wants to change the appointment. 'Werktage' = Monday–Saturday, excluding only Sundays and public holidays. Counting backwards from the delivery date Saturday 12.12.2026 (not counted itself): 1st Werktag before = Fri 11.12.2026; 2nd = Thu 10.12.2026; 3rd = Wed 09.12.2026. No public holidays fall in this window in NW. So the call must be made by Wednesday 09.12.2026 at the latest.
